transcript: Buena Vista Social Club on Broadway is a quintessential love letter to music. Based on the award-winning album of Cuban classics, this new musical jumps between the late 90s and the 50s offering us a reunion story over the music that was vital to our protagonists during the toughest of circumstances. I had the pleasure of seeing the off-Broadway production in 2023, and it seems that giving it the Broadway treatment has involved paring down the book even more, settling the movement into a larger space, and bolstering the production value. I did miss some of the intimacy and subtleties from its world premiere, but it's still a really thrilling experience and the music speaks for itself. The band is on stage for the majority of the two-hour show, and the level of talent and musicianship among the vocalists and instrumentalists is astonishing and well worth the price of admission. The songs are all performed in Spanish but you definitely don't need to speak Spanish for the music to completely take you away. It's really exciting that we're getting Latin music on Broadway performed at such a high caliber of talent and authenticity, so if you love music, this production is unmissable. It's not a perfect show or musical, but it's a damn good showcase of music. With that, another playbill for my collection.
